Changes how many meters one unit of the world is, which [CreateListener](CreateListener) sets first. It sets the distances that volume falls off over and how fast things move for the doppler shift. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; The ship model is built at a tenth of real size.
ListenerDistance 10
```
@param value  Meters per unit of the world. It has to be above 0, anything else is a runtime error.
@param fade_ms  How many milliseconds it takes to get to the new value. `0` (the default) changes it at once. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap [GetListenerDistance](GetListenerDistance) tells the value.
